'''Avrak Villachor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun sector chief|Sector Chief]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]]. He was known for holding the [[Festival of Four Honorings]] at his home, the [[Marblewood Estate]] in [[Iltarr City]]. As a sector [[Chief/Legends|chief]], he was charged with keeping [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] personal blackmail files safe within his vault. They were later stolen by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] team followed by the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Black Sun [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Qazadi]] in his home. Following this, Villachor knew Black Sun would seek vengeance and sought protection from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
